zh.title: 行動權限：功能、時機與拒絕後的行為
zh.summary: 權限把應用程式連到受限制資料或動作。從使用者正在做的事出發，檢查最少需要什麼，以及拒絕後能否正常退回。
objectives: 區分宣告權限與執行時取得權限。
用功能對照表檢查過度要求與撤銷後行為。

sections.heading: 需要權限的功能要說清楚
paragraphs: Android 權限依類型有安裝時、執行時與特殊權限等機制。宣告需要某權限不代表使用者已授予；應在真正存取前核對狀態，依平台流程請求。不同 Android 與 target SDK 版本也可能影響行為。
先問功能能否用較少資料完成。例如選取一張照片，可能有系統選取器等較窄的方式，而不需要讀取整個媒體庫。權限應與當下功能相連，讓使用者理解目的。

sections.heading: 拒絕與撤銷也是正常狀態
paragraphs: 使用者可以拒絕、撤銷或只在部分情境授權。應用應重新核對狀態並提供可理解的替代路徑，例如錄音被拒絕時仍可打字，不反覆施壓要求與主要功能無關的權限。
權限清單只能顯示可取得的能力，不能單獨證明資料已外傳。若要判斷實際資料流，還需在授權測試中觀察操作、儲存與傳輸證據。

example.title: 例子：純文字筆記要求麥克風
example.scenario: 虛構筆記程式一開啟就要求麥克風，但使用者只想輸入文字，尚未選擇錄音功能。
example.reasoning: 要求時機與當下功能不一致。合理流程是在使用者啟動錄音時說明並請求；拒絕時保留文字功能。這個不合理請求本身還不能證明錄音已外傳。
example.conclusion: 指出最小權限與使用情境問題，同時保留資料流未知。

lab.title: 紙上練習：功能與權限對照
lab.environment: 只分析虛構應用，不改手機設定或安裝軟體。
steps: 列出文字筆記、錄音筆記、選取單張照片三個功能。
各寫出所需能力與請求時機。
補上拒絕或撤銷後仍可用的路徑。
lab.expected: 文字輸入不依賴麥克風；錄音才需要相應能力；圖片選取先考慮最窄的系統機制。
lab.check: 宣告麥克風權限與實際錄音外傳之間，還缺哪些證據？
lab.cleanup: 保存對照表，沒有裝置設定需要還原。

en.title: Mobile permissions: purpose, timing and behavior after denial
en.summary: Permissions connect an application to restricted data or actions. Start with the user’s current task, identify the minimum access and check graceful behavior after denial.
objectives: Distinguish declaring a permission from obtaining runtime permission.
Use a feature matrix to assess excessive requests and behavior after revocation.

sections.heading: Make the permission-dependent feature explicit
paragraphs: Android uses install-time, runtime and special-permission mechanisms. Declaring a permission does not mean the user granted it. Check before access and follow the platform request flow. Android and target SDK versions can affect behavior.

First ask whether the feature can work with less data. Selecting one photo may have a narrower system-picker route than reading an entire media library. Tie a request to the current feature so the user can understand its purpose.

sections.heading: Denial and revocation are normal states
paragraphs: Users can deny, revoke or grant access only in certain circumstances. An app should recheck state and provide understandable alternatives, such as typed input when recording is denied. It should not repeatedly pressure users for unrelated access.
A permission list shows potential capabilities, not proof that data was transmitted. Establishing actual data flow requires authorized evidence about operations, storage and transmission.

example.title: Example: a text note requests microphone access
example.scenario: A fictional note app requests microphone access at launch while the user only wants to type and has not selected recording.
example.reasoning: The timing does not match the current feature. A reasonable flow explains and requests access when recording is selected and preserves typing after denial. The inappropriate request alone does not prove audio transmission.
example.conclusion: Identify the least-privilege and context problem while keeping data transmission unknown.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: map features to permissions
lab.environment: Analyze a fictional app without changing phone settings or installing software.
steps: List typed notes, audio notes and choosing one photo.
Write the required capability and request timing for each.
Add a usable path after denial or revocation.
lab.expected: Typing does not depend on microphone access; recording needs the corresponding capability; photo selection should first consider the narrowest system mechanism.
lab.check: What evidence separates declaring microphone permission from recording and transmitting audio?
lab.cleanup: Save the matrix; no device settings require restoration.

zh.prompt: 宣告 runtime permission，是否等於使用者已授權？
options: 否，還需核對狀態並依平台流程取得
否，所有權限都永遠不能取得
rationales: 宣告與授予是不同步驟。
這符合執行時權限模型。
啟動不證明特定權限已授予。
平台提供有條件的授權流程。

en.prompt: Does declaring a runtime permission mean the user granted it?
options: No; check state and obtain it through the platform flow
No; no permission can ever be granted
rationales: Declaration and grant are different steps.
Launch does not establish a particular grant.
The platform provides conditional grant flows.

zh.prompt: 使用者拒絕錄音權限，純文字筆記應如何？
options: 在不需該權限時繼續可用
偷偷改用其他方式錄音
rationales: 替代路徑尊重功能與權限界線。
不能把拒絕改寫成同意。

en.prompt: If microphone access is denied, what should happen to typed notes?
options: Remain usable when the permission is not needed
rationales: An alternative respects feature and permission boundaries.
Denial does not authorize deleting data.
Refusal cannot be rewritten as consent.
